prompt_text: Where should I buy tires in Pleasanton CA and who does the best installation?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: For the best combination of price and reliable installation in Pleasanton, CA, consider Costco, Discount Tire (America’s Tire), or a well-reviewed independent shop — and for high-end/performance wheels consider Tire Rack shipped to a local installer. Those three options are consistently strong for purchase + quality mounting.

More detail and how to pick the best installer for you
- Costco: very competitive tire pricing for members, includes mounting and lifetime maintenance (flat repair, rotations, inflation checks). Good value if you’re a member. (Alignment is usually extra.)
- Discount Tire / America’s Tire: excellent customer service, skilled installers, good warranty/road-hazard options, and they’ll install tires you buy elsewhere in many cases.
- Tire Rack (online): often the best selection and deals on specialty or performance tires; you can have tires shipped to a Tire Rack recommended installer near you for professional mounting/balancing.
- Local independent shops: can be the best installers if they have ASE-certified technicians and good reviews. Independents sometimes give better personalized service and faster same-day installs.

What to ask/verify when you pick a shop
- Do they use a road-force balancer? (Important for eliminating vibration)
- Do they install new valve stems/TPMS service and torque lug nuts to spec?
- Do they pre- and post-mount test-drive/balance checks?
- What maintenance is included (rotations, flat repair, balancing) and any labor warranties?
- Can they perform a computerized alignment if needed and do they include it in a package?

How to choose right now
1. Get prices from Costco, Discount Tire, and one or two local shops (Google/Yelp for “tire shops Pleasanton, CA” and check recent reviews mentioning installation quality).  
2. Compare total out-the-door price (tires + mount/balance + valve stems + disposal + taxes + alignment if needed).  
3. Prefer shops that offer road-force balancing and lifetime rotation/flat-repair if you want the lowest hassle after purchase.

If you want, tell me:
- your Pleasanton ZIP code (or allow me to look up local shops), and
- your vehicle and tire type (all-season, winter, performance, truck/SUV),
and I’ll give 3–5 specific nearby shops with recent reputations for great installation.
